observation.command:
cd /workspace; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev describe 2>&1' | grep -E "web|db|openldap|phpmyadmin|STAT|Project" | head -12
echo "=== HTTP ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web bash -c 'curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "root=%{http_code}\n" http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "login=%{http_code}\n" http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login'
echo "=== LDAP count ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap bash -c 'ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b dc=example,dc=org -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w admin "(uid=*)" uid 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^uid:"'
echo "=== DB tables ==="; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev mysql -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema= \"db\";" 2>/dev/null'
